s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate
salient_findings: Erythematous papules with crusts and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip with sparing of the surrounding skin
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis, erosions, and nodular lymphocyte infiltrate
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate
salient_findings: Erythematous papules with crusts and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip with sparing of the surrounding skin
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis, erosions, and nodular lymphocyte infiltrate
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.rationale: The presence of a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center, along with CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells, is highly suggestive of cutaneous B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Lymphomatoid papulosis typically presents with a more varied and atypical lymphocytic infiltrate, which is not described in the biopsy results.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The biopsy results show CD20 positive cells, which are more characteristic of B-cell lymphomas, whereas T-cell lymphomas would typically be CD20 negative and CD3 positive.

rejected.label: Phototoxic dermatitis
rejected.why: While the patient did exhibit a delayed erythema to UV-A on phototest, the clinical presentation and biopsy results are more consistent with a lymphoproliferative disorder than a simple phototoxic reaction.

rejected.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The normal antinuclear antibodies and complement levels, along with the specific biopsy findings, make discoid lupus erythematosus less likely, as it typically presents with positive autoantibodies and distinct histological features such as interface dermatitis and follicular plugging.
